## Acceptance

- [ ] All three members install and run from clean environments using the README.
- [ ] Exact commit/tag, dependencies, contract, rule_version and source_version recorded.
- [ ] Five knowledge-base files and truthful source review logs included.
- [ ] FE/BE/RAG/E2E logs, bug records, limitations, update and rollback instructions included.
- [ ] Demonstrations and technical acceptance have actual evidence.

Evidence: reviewed PRs, acceptance document, exact commit, CI run, test logs and demonstration records.
